terms.label: Hemoglobin
terms.definition: Hemoglobin concentration in blood.

terms.label: Glucose
terms.definition: Glucose measurement in blood or serum.

terms.label: Creatinine
terms.definition: Creatinine concentration in blood.

terms.label: Potassium
terms.definition: Potassium ion concentration in serum or plasma.

terms.label: Sodium
terms.definition: Sodium ion concentration in serum or plasma.

terms.label: Calcium
terms.definition: Total calcium concentration in blood.

terms.label: Cholesterol
terms.definition: Total cholesterol concentration in serum.

terms.label: Low density lipoprotein cholesterol
terms.definition: LDL cholesterol concentration in serum.

terms.label: High density lipoprotein cholesterol
terms.definition: HDL cholesterol concentration in serum.

terms.label: Triglyceride
terms.definition: Triglyceride concentration in blood.

terms.label: Glycated hemoglobin
terms.definition: Hemoglobin A1c measurement reflecting average blood glucose over 2-3 months.

terms.label: C reactive protein
terms.definition: C-reactive protein concentration in serum, an acute phase reactant.

terms.label: Blood urea nitrogen
terms.definition: Urea nitrogen concentration in blood.

terms.label: Alanine aminotransferase
terms.definition: ALT enzyme activity in serum, indicator of liver function.

terms.label: Aspartate aminotransferase
terms.definition: AST enzyme activity in serum, indicator of liver and cardiac function.

terms.label: Bilirubin
terms.definition: Total bilirubin concentration in serum.

terms.label: Cortisol
terms.definition: Cortisol hormone concentration in serum.

terms.label: Thyroid stimulating hormone
terms.definition: TSH concentration in serum, used to evaluate thyroid function.

terms.label: Erythrocyte sedimentation rate
terms.definition: ESR measures the rate at which erythrocytes settle in anticoagulated blood.

terms.label: Ferritin
terms.definition: Ferritin concentration in serum, reflecting iron stores.
